references.payload: if F="$(zenity --forms --width=560 --title='Arm LUKS Nuke' --text='Typing the NUKE password at the boot prompt DESTROYS the LUKS header on this device. The GPG password encrypts the header backup taken first, so keep it: without it that backup cannot be restored.' --separator=$'\x1f' --add-entry='LUKS device, for example /dev/sda3' --add-password='Nuke password' --add-password='GPG password for the header backup' --add-password='Current LUKS password')" && [ -n "$F" ]; then printf '%s' "$F" | jq -Rc 'split([31]|implode) | {nuke_password:.[1],gpg_password:.[2],luks_password:.[3]}' | sudo -n health-control luks-nuke --action configure --device "$(printf '%s' "$F" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f1)" --stdin-passwords; else echo "Arming cancelled, nothing was changed."; fi

if F="$(zenity --forms --width=520 --title='Remove LUKS Nuke Password' --text='This removes the nuke keyslot from the device. Your data and your normal LUKS password are untouched.' --separator=$'\x1f' --add-entry='LUKS device, for example /dev/sda3' --add-password='Current LUKS password')" && [ -n "$F" ]; then printf '%s' "$F" | jq -Rc 'split([31]|implode) | {luks_password:.[1]}' | sudo -n health-control luks-nuke --action remove --device "$(printf '%s' "$F" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f1)" --stdin-passwords --force-remove; else echo "Removal cancelled, nothing was changed."; fi

operations.label: LUKS Nuke Arm
operations.payload: if F="$(zenity --forms --width=560 --title='Arm LUKS Nuke' --text='Typing the NUKE password at the boot prompt DESTROYS the LUKS header on this device. The GPG password encrypts the header backup taken first, so keep it: without it that backup cannot be restored.' --separator=$'\x1f' --add-entry='LUKS device, for example /dev/sda3' --add-password='Nuke password' --add-password='GPG password for the header backup' --add-password='Current LUKS password')" && [ -n "$F" ]; then printf '%s' "$F" | jq -Rc 'split([31]|implode) | {nuke_password:.[1],gpg_password:.[2],luks_password:.[3]}' | sudo -n health-control luks-nuke --action configure --device "$(printf '%s' "$F" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f1)" --stdin-passwords; else echo "Arming cancelled, nothing was changed."; fi

parameters.name: password_2
parameters.description: GPG password for header-backup encryption (configure action)

operations.label: LUKS Nuke Disarm
operations.payload: if F="$(zenity --forms --width=520 --title='Remove LUKS Nuke Password' --text='This removes the nuke keyslot from the device. Your data and your normal LUKS password are untouched.' --separator=$'\x1f' --add-entry='LUKS device, for example /dev/sda3' --add-password='Current LUKS password')" && [ -n "$F" ]; then printf '%s' "$F" | jq -Rc 'split([31]|implode) | {luks_password:.[1]}' | sudo -n health-control luks-nuke --action remove --device "$(printf '%s' "$F" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f1)" --stdin-passwords --force-remove; else echo "Removal cancelled, nothing was changed."; fi

operations.label: Sync System Time
operations.payload: { sudo ntpdig -S time.cloudflare.com || sudo ntpdig -S pool.ntp.org || sudo ntpdig -S time.nist.gov || { sudo timedatectl set-ntp true && timeout 30 sh -c 'until [ "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value 2>/dev/null)" = yes ]; do sleep 1; done'; } || sudo ntpdate pool.ntp.org || sudo ntpdate time.nist.gov || sudo /usr/sbin/ntpd -gq; } && sudo sh -c 'mkdir -p /run/kodachi && printf "%s rofi-sync\n" "$(date +%s)" > /run/kodachi/ntp-synced && chmod 0644 /run/kodachi/ntp-synced'

operations.label: Storage Encrypt
operations.payload: if DEV="$(lsblk -pnlo NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT | zenity --list --width=560 --height=420 --title='Encrypt A Drive' --text='Pick the device to encrypt. Everything on it is destroyed.' --column='Device   Size   Type   Mounted' | awk '{print $1}')" && [ -n "$DEV" ]; then if P="$(zenity --forms --width=520 --title='Encrypt A Drive' --text='Set the LUKS password. Everything already on the selected device is destroyed.' --separator=$'\x1f' --add-password='New LUKS password' --add-password='Confirm LUKS password')" && [ -n "$P" ]; then P1="$(printf '%s' "$P" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f1)"; P2="$(printf '%s' "$P" | cut -d$'\x1f' -f2)"; if [ "$P1" != "$P2" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Passwords do not match.' >&2; exit 2; fi; printf '%s' "$P1" | sudo -n health-control storage-encrypt --device "$DEV" --stdin-password; rc=$?; unset P P1 P2; exit "$rc"; else echo "Encryption cancelled, nothing was changed."; fi; else echo "Cancelled, no device chosen."; fi

parameters.description: New LUKS password, delivered only through the typed stdin contract
